label: Quotient Campaign screen (Brief / Tasks / Activation / Deliverables)
description: The Quotient campaign screen (built from actual screenshots), designed as a CENTER component for quotient-app-shell (use its content-region contract) or standalone. White card with the tab bar -- Brief / Tasks / Activation / Deliverables / Chats -- and four working views: BRIEF is the rich-text doc ('Last updated', big title, Date Range chips + Owner row with avatar, headed sections with paragraphs and bullets); TASKS is the table ('Tasks · Completed 0/6', Filters/Grouping/black New, 'To-do 6' group, rows with dashed-circle checkbox, due date, red priority bars, owner avatar, deliverable platform icon, and the 'Get Started' Quotient chat chip); ACTIVATION is the week calendar (time gutter, day columns, deliverable cards with platform badge, title, time, avatar, and Published/Draft/Launched status) where cards can be DRAGGED between days; DELIVERABLES is the status table (type icon, name, green-rocket Published vs dashed Draft, date, linked task). SCRIPTED performable surface. Camera anchors: tabs, brief, tasks, calendar, deliverables.

active_tab.label: Tab at open: brief (default) | tasks | activation | deliverables

tasks.label: Task rows: [{text, due: 'Jul 5', priority: 'high'|'medium'|'low', owner: 'Marc F...', avatar_url, platform: 'linkedin'|'x', deliverable: 'Marc LinkedI...', done?}]

calendar.label: Activation calendar: {days: 5, hours: [{label: '9 AM', pct: 34}], events: [{day: 0-4, top: %, type: 'Social Post'|'Email Broadcast'|'Blog', platform: 'linkedin'|'x'|'email'|'blog', title, time: '9:00 AM', status: 'published'|'draft'|'launched', avatar_url}]}

deliverables.label: Deliverable rows: [{platform, kind: 'Social Post', name, status: 'published'|'draft'|'scheduled', date, task}]

script.label: Actions: switch-tab {tab: 'brief'|'tasks'|'activation'|'deliverables'} (tab press + view crossfade -- THE tour beat), complete-task {index} (checkbox fills green, Completed count ticks), move-event {index, day, top?} (the calendar card LIFTS with a shadow and glides to another day column -- the drag-and-drop beat), set-event-status {index, status} (calendar card status flips, e.g. draft -> published), set-deliverable-status {index, status} (table status flips to the green rocket), scroll-view {amount, duration}. Plus base actions (move-cursor, click, wait). NEVER move the camera from a script -- scene camera_moves with anchors (tabs, brief, tasks, calendar, deliverables).

script_actions.description: Press a tab; the view crossfades in
A task's dashed circle fills green with a check; the Completed counter ticks up
The drag-and-drop beat: the calendar card lifts (scale + shadow) and glides to another day column / time
Flip a calendar card's status pill (draft -> published gets the green rocket)
